name: CPW World Heavyweight Title
epitaph: Changed hands nineteen times across seven years, ending in a five-way match the same month the IWF itself closed.

name: CPW World Tag Team Title
epitaph: Changed hands sixteen times across five years, ending with the York Brothers the same month the IWF itself closed.

name: CPW International Television Title
epitaph: Began as the CPW Provincial Title and was renamed International partway through, changing hands fourteen times before an irregular final defense posted after the IWF's own closure.

name: CPW Young Blood Challenge Title
epitaph: Attested for two reigns before the surviving record breaks off.

name: CPW Lethal Ladies Title
epitaph: Attested for two reigns, both held by the same wrestler, before the surviving record breaks off.

name: CPW North Continental Title
epitaph: Attested for one reign before the surviving record breaks off.

name: CPW Bunkhouse Title
epitaph: Attested for one reign, won at the league's own IWF Birthday Bash event, before the surviving record breaks off.
